hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s governance and economic policies under scrutiny
hotspots.blurb: Argentina’s President Javier Milei faces intense scrutiny over his economic policies, including labor reforms, inflation control, and public sector cuts. hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high stakes of Argentina’s economic crisis and Milei’s polarizing leadership style, which has drawn both fervent support and fierce opposition.

The talks have sparked controversy over Vox’s demands, including the implementation of 'national priority' policies and the exclusion of migrant-friendly NGOs from public funding.

hotspots.title: Hungary’s constitutional crisis over president’s removal
hotspots.blurb: Hungary’s new Prime Minister, Péter Magyar, has threatened to amend the constitution to remove President Tamás Sulyok, who was appointed by former Prime Minister Viktor Orbán. The standoff has escalated into a full-blown constitutional crisis, with Magyar accusing Sulyok of failing to represent national unity and obstructing the new government’s agenda.
hotspots.affect: This story is highly charged due to its implications for Hungary’s democratic institutions, the potential for a power struggle between the executive and presidency, and the broader context of Orbán’s legacy.
